Wayland Games is Europe's largest independent retailer for tabletop hobbies and games. You'll find amazing discounts on Games Workshop favourites like Warhammer 40K, Age of Sigmar and Warhammer The Old World, as well as painting and modelling supplies and tabletop scenery and terrain.

We’re passionate about all things tabletop, stocking a wide range of board games and popular roleplaying games  like Dungeons & Dragons and Vampire: The Masquerade too! You’ll also find a selection of trading card game favourites like Pokemon TCG, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh! and Lorcana. Alongside these, we proudly feature exciting new releases from our favourite game publishers, no matter how big or small.

So, however you love to play, Wayland Games is ready to support your hobby, online and in-store.

waylandgames.co.uk is the sales website for Wayland Games Centre Brentwood, Unit 3a London Brentwood Commercial Park, Tilbury Road, West Horndon, Brentwood, Essex, CM13 3LR, United Kingdom.
